CQ2.question: What are the abstract specifications of MyWebApp?

CQ3.question: Which microservices have an inconsistent deployment?

CQ4.question: Which Kubernetes configurations use an out-of-range NodePort?
CQ4.query:
SELECT ?cfg ?p WHERE { ?cfg a mw:KubernetesConfig ; mw:hasResource ?r .
                 ?r a mw:NodePortResource ; mw:hasNodePortValue ?p . FILTER(?p < 30000 || ?p > 32767) }

CQ5.question: Which platform-specific parameters does each configuration of DataAggregator define?

CQ6.question: Which microservices target more than one platform?
CQ6.query:
SELECT ?ms (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?n) WHERE { ?ms mw:hasPlatformConfig ?c . }
               GROUP BY ?ms HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) > 1)

CQ7.question: Which microservices replicate a workload over shared ReadWriteOnce storage?

CQ8.question: On which infrastructure targets is each microservice deployed?

CQ9.question: On which microservices does MyWebApp depend?

CQ10.question: Which microservices are affected if PaymentProcessor fails?

CQ11.question: Which dependencies do not resolve to an endpoint of their deployment unit?
CQ11.query:
SELECT ?ms ?host WHERE { ?ms mw:hasDependency ?d . ?d mw:dependsOnHost ?host .
                  FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?d mw:resolvesTo ?e } }
